rows.label: Conditions
rows.text: ❌ 'KCL applies to open circuits.' ✅ KCL (junction rule) applies only at *nodes/junctions* where currents meet; it states ΣI_in = ΣI_out.  ·  ❌ 'KVL is valid for any loop including those with capacitors.' ✅ KVL applies to *closed loops*; for capacitors, you must include the potential difference V = q/C across the capacitor.

rows.label: Limitation
rows.text: ❌ 'Sign conventions for KVL don't matter as long as you're consistent.' ✅ While consistency is key, wrong sign conventions will flip *all* your results; the standard rule is: voltage rise = +, voltage drop = − when traversing the loop.
